target_customer: Commercial general contractors, and subcontractors and suppliers who receive bid invites
problem: General contractors manually read plans, work out scopes and chase subcontractors for bids. Downtobid uses AI to identify scopes of work, recommend subcontractors and automate bid invites and follow-ups.

founders.name: Andy Lee
previous_startups: BasisBoard (bidding product for subcontractors, built with Wu for about five years per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC company page. Technical status inferred from the self-driving role, so it is a judgment.

founders.name: Kevin Wu
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists a past career as a professional gamer. Technical flag is a judgment from the design role.

technical_complexity.rationale: Reading construction plans with machine learning and matching scopes to subcontractors is a hard-ish applied problem, but largely standard software with a workflow wrapper.

defensibility.rationale: A verified subcontractor database helps, but BuildingConnected, PlanHub and others hold far larger networks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Dodge Construction Network now sells Bid Board by Downtobid as a product, which suggests a tie-up with Dodge; no deal announcement or date found.

market_need_then: Bid coordination was manual work for general contractors; the founders spent about five years on the BasisBoard subcontractor bidding product before Downtobid, per the YC page.

branding.domain_note: Uses downtobid.com; acquisition history not found.

rebrands.to: Bid Board by Downtobid (within Dodge product line)
rebrands.why: Dodge lists the product under this name; date and reason not found

brand_strength.rationale: Colloquial phrase turned into a name; no press or community evidence about the brand itself was found, and the site was blocked on fetch.

outcome_analysis: Downtobid is a small two founder team that had built the BasisBoard bidding product for years and went through YC Summer 2019. It surfaced publicly with a 3.4M round in September 2024 and 10 general contractors. The YC directory says Acquired, and Dodge Construction Network now lists Bid Board by Downtobid as its product and a Dodge entity appears as trademark owner, but no deal announcement, date or price was found, so the nature of the outcome is uncertain.
notes: Funding: the 3.4M round is from the company's own press release (seen via search snippet, page fetch returned 429); the release does not label the stage so it is recorded as other.
